project_name: LexDocket - Shared Law Firm Color-Coded Deadline & Task Manager
design_archetype: Swiss & Tactical Precision / Law Firm Executive Desk
theme: Dark / Light Toggle (Default: High-contrast Dark Slate for maximum clarity and eye safety during late docket reviews)

typography.font_family_heading: Plus Jakarta Sans, SF Pro Display, system-ui, sans-serif

hierarchy.table_header: text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400

visual_enhancers.auto_refresh_badge: inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-mono font-medium bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/20

layout_and_grid.header_bar: w-full border-b border-slate-800 bg-slate-900/90 backdrop-blur px-6 py-4 flex items-center justify-between sticky top-0 z-40
layout_and_grid.metrics_grid: grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 px-6 pt-6 pb-2
layout_and_grid.filter_bar: px-6 py-4 bg-slate-900/40 border-y border-slate-800/60 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4
layout_and_grid.main_container: max-w-[1700px] mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 py-6 space-y-6
layout_and_grid.table_container: rounded-xl border border-slate-800 bg-slate-900/70 overflow-hidden shadow-xl shadow-black/40

component_guidelines.file_extensions: Use .js and .jsx files as established in frontend/src
component_guidelines.shadcn_components: Utilize existing Shadcn primitives in src/components/ui/ (table.jsx, dialog.jsx, context-menu.jsx, dropdown-menu.jsx, select.jsx, badge.jsx, sonner.jsx, tooltip.jsx)

table_features.relative_deadline: Display both exact date (e.g. Oct 24, 2026) and relative calculation badge (e.g. 'In 3 days', 'Due Today', 'OVERDUE by 2 days'). Highlight overdue items in bold red pulse.
table_features.hyperlink_cell: If URL is provided, render clickable anchor tag with external link icon; truncate cleanly with hover tooltip for full URL.
table_features.updated_by: Display updated timestamp formatted nicely (e.g. 'Oct 20, 14:32') along with author name taken from logged-in account.

component_guidelines.right_click_context_menu: Right-clicking any table row presents a context menu with options: 'Set Urgency' (Green, Blue, Yellow, Red color chips), 'Edit Task', 'Duplicate Task', 'Copy Matter No', and 'Delete Task'.
component_guidelines.double_click_action: Double-clicking any table row triggers the Edit Task dialog immediately.
component_guidelines.polling: Auto-refreshes task list from backend every 5 seconds. Shows a subtle pulsing status dot with manual 'Sync Now' button.

filters.search_input: Full text search matching task title, assignee, matter number, or notes.
filters.matter_select: Dropdown list of all unique matter numbers present + all matters option.
filters.urgency_pills: Filter pills for All, Green (OK), Blue (Not Urgent), Yellow (Near Term), Red (Urgent).

component_guidelines.backup_and_restore: Download backup produces a structured .json file containing all tasks & settings. Restore feature accepts upload of valid JSON file with clear confirmation dialog.

avatars.description: User profile avatar male senior partner

accessibility_and_testing.wcag_contrast: Ensure color-coded rows maintain text contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 against background colors.
accessibility_and_testing.keyboard_navigation: Context menu accessible via keyboard shortcuts or action button per row.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. In frontend design, avoid AI slop and build a polished law-firm style docket command center.
Dark colors look good when used independently without generic noisy gradients.
DO NOT apply universal transition (e.g. transition: all). Apply specific transitions on hover and background color changes.
NEVER center-align the app container body. Keep left-aligned natural legal desk table layout.
NEVER use AI assistant emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭. Use Lucide SVG icons (e.g., AlertTriangle, Clock, Calendar, Scale, Link, Filter, Search, User, Shield).
Ensure every interaction (hover, context menu, modal popup, filter toggle) has subtle micro-animations.
Include data-testid on all key interactive elements as specified in test_ids.
